title: Plaintext Wikipedia (SimpleEnglish)
subtitle: Built by cheeseonamonkey/PlainTextWikipedia
description:
Compressed plaintext Simple English Wikipedia articles. Each article title precedes its cleaned text.

Created and maintained by [cheeseonamonkey/PlainTextWikipedia](https://github.com/cheeseonamonkey/PlainTextWikipedia), the maintained fork that builds and publishes this dataset. Based on the original unmaintained project [daveshap/PlainTextWikipedia](https://github.com/daveshap/PlainTextWikipedia). Source data: official Wikimedia dumps.
